name: Faroe Islands
summary_text: Faroe Islands: home rule with its own legislation; marriage equality came late (2017) after church-state friction; tight-knit conservative Lutheran society. Scored as a dependent jurisdiction: the parent framework governs what a visitor encounters, plus local society and enforcement. Score re-anchored 2026-09-24: Denmark (0.85) plus a local delta of -0.04. This jurisdiction was not covered by the dedicated state/province research passes.

sources.title: Denmark's decade of self-ID cools debate on trans rights | Context by TRF
sources.claim_summary: Context/Thomson Reuters Foundation (Sept 2024) on Denmark's decade of self-ID - included for the Faroe Islands as part of the Danish Realm; the self-ID framework and its low-conflict implementation provide regional context.

sources.title: Denmark | Outright International
sources.claim_summary: Outright International country overview for Denmark (updated March 2026), included for the Faroe Islands as part of the Danish Realm: robust protections, self-determined gender markers, 'X' passports, SOGISC discrimination protections. (The Faroe Islands has its own legislation, with self-ID-style recognition adopted there in 2017.)

sources.title: Homophobia "perfectly legal" in Faroe Islands | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (Nov 2006): 'Homophobia perfectly legal in Faroe Islands' - LGBT activists gathered ~20,000 signatures demanding anti-discrimination protection and a registered-partnership law to match the Nordic region; documents that violence and discrimination against out gay people were 'not uncommon' with no legal protection.

sources.title: Faroe Islands MP refuses to dine with Iceland's gay prime minister and her partner | PinkNews
sources.claim_summary: PinkNews (Sept 2010): Faroese MP Jenis av Rana (Centre Party) refused to attend a state banquet for Iceland's gay prime minister Jóhanna Sigurðardóttir and her wife, calling the visit 'a direct provocation' - the incident sparked controversy in both countries.

sources.title: More Voices | Patheos
sources.claim_summary: Patheos/Friendly Atheist (Sept 2010): coverage of the same Faroese MP's snub of Iceland's gay PM - the religious-political context of the Faroe Islands.

sources.title: Singer Eivør Pálsdóttir: Ignore Jenis av Rana - GayIceland
sources.claim_summary: Gay Iceland (July 2015): Faroese singer Eivør Pálsdóttir responded to MP Jenis av Rana's demand to ban Pride festivals (held two days before the national holiday) - 'narrow minded opinions like these should be ignored'; documents ongoing anti-Pride politics in the Faroes.
